pick.headline: Mathias Rust sentenced for his Red Square landing

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 172, 4 September 1987
evidence.snippet: FBIS- -87-172 4 September 87 West Europe Rust Trial Proceedings Continue Prosecutor Asks 8 Years LD032035 Moscow World Service in English 1800 GMT 3 Sep 87 [Excerpt] At the trial in Moscow of the West German citizen Mathias Rust who in May violated Soviet air- space in a light engine sports plane, the Prosecutor Vladimir Andreyev has requested an 8-year prison sen- tence. [passage omitted] Gerasimov Silent on Rust LD040948 Hamburg DPA in German…
